summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of SaaS Chatbot Management Platform. All backend APIs (13/13) and frontend flows (18/18) passed successfully. Tested client panel (login, dashboard, training, channels with modals), admin panel (login, companies, company details with sync logs, licenses), license banner behavior, and theme/language toggles.

Backend: GET /api/companies - Returns license join with c2 expired status
Backend: GET /api/license/status?companyId=c2 - Returns expired status
Backend: GET /api/license/status?companyId=c1 - Returns active status
Backend: POST /api/admin/login - Success with admin@saas.com/admin123
Backend: POST /api/admin/login - Correctly rejects wrong credentials (401)
Backend: POST /api/licenses - Issues new license for c2 with pro plan
Backend: POST /api/licenses/{id}/renew - Renews license and extends expiration
Backend: PUT /api/channels/c1/whatsapp - Updates channel status to active
Backend: PUT /api/channels/c1/tiktok - Correctly returns 400 (TikTok disabled)
Backend: GET /api/bot-config/c1 - Returns bot configuration
Backend: PUT /api/bot-config/c1 - Updates and persists bot configuration
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/c1 - Returns metrics with conversasSemana array
Frontend: Login page - Select c2 (Pousada Vista Mar) and navigate to dashboard
Frontend: License banner - Visible for c2 (expired), dismissible, reappears on reload
Frontend: Dashboard - Displays 4 metric cards and weekly conversations chart
Frontend: Treinamento - Loads config, edits persona, adds FAQ, saves, persists after reload
Frontend: Canais - Displays 5 channel cards (WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, WebChat, TikTok)
Frontend: WhatsApp modal - Opens, displays simulated QR code, connects on 'Já escaneei' click
Frontend: Telegram modal - Opens, accepts bot token input, connects channel
Frontend: Instagram modal - Opens, simulates OAuth flow (loading -> linked with handle)
Frontend: WebChat modal - Opens, displays embed code, copy button exists and is clickable
Frontend: TikTok - Toggle disabled, 'Em breve' badge displayed correctly
Frontend: Channel toggles - State persists after page reload
Frontend: Admin login - Authenticates with admin@saas.com/admin123, navigates to /admin/empresas
Frontend: Admin empresas - Lists 3 companies, c2 shows 'Expirada' badge
Frontend: Admin company detail (c3) - Shows On-Premise badge, sync logs with heartbeat/version/status/metrics
Frontend: Admin licenses - Lists licenses, issue form works, issues new license for c2
Frontend: License banner disappears - After issuing new license for c2, banner no longer visible
